# Scenario Motion Loops references

Official gallery: https://www.scenario.com/explorations/motion-loops/

These five HTML files were copied from the gallery's visible “Loop source code” panel on 2026-10-28. Line-number display elements were excluded; source comments and drawing code were preserved. They are source references, not loaded by the manga reader.

- reference-halftone-wave.html — Backgrounds 17, Halftone Wave
- reference-line-burst.html — Backgrounds 11, Line Burst
- reference-orbit-dots.html — Backgrounds 24, Orbit Dots
- reference-split-panels.html — Backgrounds 34, Split Panels
- reference-arc-rotation.html — Backgrounds 35, Arc Rotation

Official reusable template and repository licence:

- https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills/blob/main/skills/scenario-motion-loops/scripts/loop-template.html
- https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills/blob/main/LICENSE

The reader's loop-ink.js adapts the time-based drawing algorithms to transparent, sparse manga ink, a shared page clock and protected text/artwork areas. It does not load the standalone HTML runners or call Scenario's generation services.
